## Tips for Finding the Best Installation

- **Read recent reviews** on Google Maps and Yelp specifically mentioning installation quality
- **Compare prices** - installation costs vary significantly
- **Ask about warranties** on both tires and installation work
- **Check turnaround times** - some shops get busy
- **Look for certifications** (ASE-certified technicians are a good sign)
